verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI app-building tool, but the evidence pack shows no rule engine or event-based triggers in Figma Make. Reusable instruction packages, guidelines, and MCP connections are manually invoked context or workflow aids, not rules that fire actions automatically on events, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
